# webbpulse_registry_provider (Resource)

A private provider in the registry, connected to a GitHub repository named `terraform-provider-<type>`. Each published GitHub release carrying signed GoReleaser artifacts publishes that version. Versions publish in the background, so read them with the `webbpulse_registry_provider` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "webbpulse_registry_provider" "example" {
  vcs_repo {
    identifier = "WebbPulse/terraform-provider-example"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `import_releases` (Boolean) Whether connecting imports the repository's existing releases. Read only on create, so changing it later does nothing. Defaults to `true`.
- `resync_triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values whose change queues an import of every release in the repository, in place. Published versions are left alone.
- `vcs_repo` (Block, Optional) The GitHub repository the provider publishes from, through the environment's GitHub App. It has to be named `terraform-provider-<type>`. Required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--vcs_repo))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the provider was connected.
- `id` (String) The provider address, `namespace/type`.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace, which is the repository owner.
- `source` (String) The address a `required_providers` source names after the registry host.
- `type` (String) The provider type, from the repository name `terraform-provider-<type>`.

<a id="nestedblock--vcs_repo"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vcs_repo`

Optional:

- `identifier` (String) The repository as `owner/name`. The owner becomes the namespace. The environment's GitHub App has to be installed on it, or the apply fails with `VCS_REPO_NOT_INSTALLED`. Changing it replaces the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import webbpulse_registry_provider.example WebbPulse/example
```
